phase.definition: Declared activity phase; not inferred from task content or scores.

permission.definition: Declared assistance policy; permission is not observation of use.

observed_use.definition: Source assertion about recording assistance use within its capture boundary; not_recorded is not proof of absence.

capture.definition: Declared instrument coverage within an explicit boundary; outside help remains unobserved.

capture_boundary.definition: Source-declared system, event classes and period within which coverage is asserted.

product_version.definition: Version reported by source; absence remains unknown.

model_version.definition: AI model version reported by source; absence remains unknown.

event_types.help_requested: Source explicitly records a request; no delivery is inferred.
event_types.help_generated: Source explicitly records creation of assistance; transmission is not inferred.
event_types.help_transmitted: Source explicitly records transmission; display is not inferred.
event_types.help_displayed: Source explicitly records display; reading, understanding and learning are not inferred.
event_types.learner_response_observed: Source explicitly records a subsequent learner action; causal benefit and understanding are not inferred.

review.scope: Executable mapping checks do not establish semantic validity or educational effectiveness.

tutormoments.original_event_time: Preserve source timestamp or relative offsets separately. Import entry time is the importer observation time. Missing absolute source timestamps remain null.

coverage.boundary: Selected released transcript text and offsets; no original recording or outside-help capture.

tutormoments.definition: One released transcript turn is imported as one observed dialogue turn. Source Tutor role is not a help-delivery label.
transformations: Preserve source turn order, speaker, text and relative offsets
Record importer actor and import time separately from historical speaker and unknown source clock
information_loss: Known original identity columns are excluded from event data
Model-generated enrichments are not imported as observations
Audio fidelity and external assistance cannot be checked from released text
tutormoments.pooling_limit: Dialogue-turn counts cannot be combined with participant summaries or assistance-event counts. Published companion interval coding is a separate measurement profile.

review.scope: Executable mapping checks do not establish semantic validity or educational effectiveness.

oatutor.original_event_time: Preserve source timestamp or relative offsets separately. Import entry time is the importer observation time. Missing absolute source timestamps remain null.

coverage.boundary: Participant summary table; no individual assistance timeline.

oatutor.definition: One participant table row is imported as one observed summary. Assigned hint condition is not observed use.
transformations: Retain original reported metric strings and missing values
Record importer observation time; original event clock is unknown
information_loss: Known participant identifier is excluded from event data
No help requests, generated hints, transmissions or displays are recoverable from summary rows
oatutor.pooling_limit: Assigned conditions and reported outcomes do not enter assistance-event or coded-interval denominators.

review.scope: Executable mapping checks do not establish semantic validity or educational effectiveness.

explicit-assistance-events.original_event_time: Preserve source timestamp or relative offsets separately. Import entry time is the importer observation time. Missing absolute source timestamps remain null.
explicit-assistance-events.denominator: Distinct native event identities within one declared capture boundary and active source revision; counts stratified by event_type.
explicit-assistance-events.definition: One explicit source lifecycle assertion is imported as one observation. Lifecycle states remain separate; no state implies a later one.
transformations: Scope learner pseudonym to adapter, source_id, tenant and key
Preserve source event_id, revision, lifecycle type, assistance/request links and optional timestamp
Normalize declared context with unknown defaults; no text-based inference
information_loss: Known learner source identifier is not copied into event data
A matching input shape establishes neither source authenticity nor measurement validity
explicit-assistance-events.pooling_limit: Requires independently reviewed compatible source mappings, lifecycle definitions, units, denominators, coding and capture coverage. Synthetic fixtures cannot support empirical product claims.

pooling: Compatibility is a conservative descriptive screen, not a transportability proof, independence assumption or causal inference license.
